Name: Plant Fruit Trees in Forest
Author: Lumisteria
Description:
This mod is a simple mod allowing you to plant fruits trees in forest. You can plant them in dirt and must still follow vanilla rules about placement, like distance with other trees, including wild trees.

This still let you plenty of spots for growing more fruit trees.



It's a very small mod, here to give a bit more immersion and allowing some more space for fruit trees. If you want to grow fruit trees everywhere or get something more powerful, consider one of the other mods allowing to plant fruit trees outside of farm :)
